title: Soft and Comfy...Barely Gets Warm
text:
Soft and Comfy...Barely Gets Warm. The blanket itself is quite soft and comfy. The kind you want to be under while watching late night movies, during a winter storm or when you're not feeling well. However, it should be noted the wiring can be felt through the blanket. Its noticeable but not terribly uncomfortable.

The blanket comes in two sizes: 50" x 60" and 62" x 84". (I ordered the 50" x 60" size) and your choice of two colors, blue or red. It is machine washable-make sure to follow the specific washing/drying instructions...VERY important.

There are 10 heat settings that range from 68-122 degrees as well as 10 auto-turn off energy saving settings that last from 1-10 hours. When my sister and I were little and had electric blankets, she often forgot to turn hers off each morning. The auto-shut off feature is great for energy saving but also for safety as well.

Unfortunately, we apparently received a defective blanket. It does not heat to 122 degrees. It barely gets warm. I ordered this for my husband who gets cold easily due to medication he takes but it doesn't really provide more warmth than a regular, basic blanket.
